info.name: Platform Master API Engine — Comprehensive Test Suite
info.description: Full-Stack API Test Suite for Hyperlocal Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Engine. Perfectly structured into System Probes, Customer Workflows, Merchant Operational Hubs, Rider Portal, and Shared Infrastructure. Contains pre-configured request payloads, parameter variations, expected response schema templates, and automatic token management.

request.description: Returns process health status, uptime, and active runtime environment.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 and healthy', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('healthy'); });

request.description: Verifies MongoDB connection state, Redis health, and memory footprint.
Fetches live OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger schema specification.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 and valid JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().openapi).to.exist; });

request.description: Registers a customer account. Creates token pair and persists profile in users collection.
Authenticates customer identity. Stores token in customerToken collection variable.
Authenticates merchant identity. Stores token in merchantToken collection variable.

exec: if (res.data && (res.data.tokens?.accessToken || res.data.accessToken)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('merchantToken', res.data.tokens?.accessToken || res.data.accessToken); if (res.data.user?.storeId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('storeId', res.data.user.storeId); } }
